title: Irejista Yamalungu Eklabhu Yangasese eNingizimu Afrika: Umhlahlandlela Osebenzayo
description: Indlela amakilabhu angasese aseNingizimu Afrika angakha ngayo irejista yamalungu ehlanzekile: izinkambu, umnakekeli nokulungela i-audit.

sections.heading: Kungani irejista iyisisekelo seklabhu yangasese
paras: Iklabhu yangasese yamalungu eNingizimu Afrika, empeleni, iyuhlu lwabantu abajoyine ngaphansi kwemithetho yeklabhu. Konke okunye, kusukela ekulawulweni kokungena kuya ekuqoqweni kwezimali nasekubikeleni kwekomidi, kuxhomeke kuleyo lisi. Uma irejista ingaphelele noma ihlakazekile kumaspredishithi, emaqenjini e-WhatsApp nasemafomini ephepha, yonke enye inqubo iyakuzuza ukubuka kwayo.

Phatha irejista njengerekhodi elilawulwayo hhayi njengento elula nje. Kufanele ibe nomnikazi oyedwa, indlela echazwe kahle yokufaka nokushintsha okufakiwe, kanye nomlando obonisa ukuthi ubani oshintshe ini nini. Lowo mkhuba wenza ikomidi likwazi ukuphendula imibuzo mayelana nenani lamalungu ngokuzethemba kunokuqagela nje.

sections.heading: Izinkambu okufanele zibe khona kuyo yonke irejista yeklabhu
paras: Qala ngezisekelo: igama eligcwele ngokomthetho, inombolo eyingqayizivele yelungu, usuku lokujoyina, isigaba selungu, isimo (liyasebenza, lisesikhashana, liphelelwe, lisishiyile) kanye nendlela ethandwayo yokuxhumana. Engeza usuku ilungu elamukele ngalo imithetho yeklabhu kanye nenguqulo yemithetho elayamukelayo, ngoba imithetho iyashintsha futhi kungase kudingeke ukukhombisa ukuthi iyiphi inguqulo eyayisebenza.

Gcina kuphela lokho okudingayo ngempela. Uma inombolo yedokhumenti yobuwena noma ikhophi yayo idingwa yimithetho yeklabhu noma yimibandela yelayisense, rekhoda ukuthi ibonwe, ngubani oyibonile nangaluphi usuku, bese ugcina okuncane okudingekayo. Gwema amanothi abhalwe ngokukhululekile ngezimo zomuntu siqu; adala ubungozi futhi akuvamile ukwengeza nanto.

sections.heading: Ukugcina irejista ilungile usuku ngosuku
paras: Misa isimiso. Izicelo ezintsha ziya efomini elilodwa lokwamukela, esinyathelweni esisodwa sokuvuma nasendaweni eyodwa yokufaka idatha. Izinguquko zekheli, zenombolo yocingo noma zesigaba ziza ngesicelo esirekhodiwe, hhayi ngokuhlela okusheshayo kwanoma ubani ongaphezu kwe-shift. Yenza ukuhlola kwenyanga ngenyanga okuqhathanisa inani lamalungu asebenzayo namarekhodi okukhishwa kwamakhadi nokukhokhwa kwezimali zelungu.

Amarekhodi aphindiwe yiwona nkinga evame kakhulu. Vumelana ngomthetho wokufanisa, njengegama kanye nosuku lokuzalwa kanye nenombolo yeselula, bese uhlanganisa okuphindiwe ngenhloso, ugcine inombolo yelungu endala. Uhlelo olufana ne-Budify lungaphoqelela izinombolo zamalungu eziyingqayizivele futhi lugcine umkhondo we-audit, kodwa umthetho uqobo kufanele usethwe yiklabhu.

sections.heading: Ukugcinwa, ukufinyelela nokusayina
paras: Linganisa ngokubhalwe phansi ukuthi amarekhodi amalungu asishiyile noma aphelelwe agcinwa isikhathi esingakanani nokuthi ubani ongawabona. Akuwona wonke umuntu osebenzayo odinga ukufinyelela okuphelele; umamukeli wasemnyango angadinga igama, isithombe nesimo kuphela, kuyilapho umphathi ebona imininingwane yokuxhumana. Buyekeza lezi zimvume njalo ngekota bese ususa ukufinyelela kwanoma ubani osehambile.

Ekugcineni, lisayinise ikomidi umbiko omfushane werejista njalo ngenyanga: inani eliphelele lamalungu ngesigaba, abajoyine, abasishiyile nokuhlukile. Ngenxa yokuthi kuhilelekile ulwazi lomuntu siqu, ihlanganise indlela yakho yokusebenza ne-POPIA ngokujwayelekile.

sections.heading: Ukubuyekezwa kwerejista kwaminyaka yonke okulula
paras: Kanye ngonyaka, thatha isithombe senkathi serejista bese uyihamba nekomidi. Bala amalungu ngesigaba, qinisekisa ukuthi ilungu ngalinye elisebenzayo linosuku lokujoyina olurekhodiwe nokwamukela imithetho, bese ulenza uhlu lwamarekhodi anemininingwane engekho noma ekhohlisayo yokuxhumana.

Vumelana ngohlelo lokuhlanza olunabanikazi nezinsuku. Xhumana namalungu anemininingwane ebonakala iphelelwe yisikhathi, buyekeza noma uvale amarekhodi, bese uphawula umphumela kumaminithi. Lokhu kuguqula irejista isuke ibe umthwalo wokuphatha ibe umthombo othenjwayo. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Amarekhodi Aselungele I-audit: Isimiso Seviki Samakilabhu aseNingizimu Afrika
description: Isimiso esilula seviki nenyanga esigcina amarekhodi amalungu, esitoko nemali ehambisana, ukuze iklabhu yangasese ihlale ilungele ukubuyekezwa.

sections.heading: Okushiwo ngempela ukuba selungele i-audit
paras: Ukulungela i-audit akushiyo ukuphelela; kusho ukuthi noma yiliphi inani noma isinqumo singalandelwa siye kurekhodi lomthombo ngaphandle kokukhathazeka. Ilungu lekomidi, i-accountant noma umhloli wangaphandle kufanele akwazi ukukhetha usuku abone ukuthi ubani ojoyine, yini engene noma yaphuma esitokweni, nokuthi imali yosuku yavumelaniswa kanjani.

Emakilabhwini angasese amalungu aseNingizimu Afrika, okulindelwe kuvame ukuvela ezindaweni ezintathu: umthethosisekelo weklabhu yakho, imibandela yelayisense noma ye-permit lapho isebenza, kanye ne-accountant yakho. Ngenxa yokuthi izidingo ziyahlukahluka, bhala phansi ukuthi imuphi umthombo ofuna amarekhodi ayiphi, bese ubuyekeza lolo hlu kanye ngonyaka nommeli wasendaweni.

sections.heading: Isimiso seviki
paras: Khetha usuku lweviki oluqinile. Okokuqala, vumelanisa irejista yamalungu: abajoyine abasha nezicelo ezisayiniwe, izinguquko zesimo nezinqumo zekomidi. Okwesibili, hlela umbiko wezinhlelo zesitoko bese uwuqhathanisa nokuhlola okungokoqobo kwesampula yemigqa. Okwesithathu, qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imali yesandla namakhadi ku-till iyavumelana nemibiko yasebhange neyokuhlalisana kwe-terminal.

Rekhoda okuhlukile endaweni eyodwa. Okuhlukile yikho konke okungavumelananga: isiginesha engekho, umehluko wesitoko, ibhishi lekhadi elingazange lihlalisane. Ngalinye linikezwa umnikazi, inothi lembangela nosuku lokuvalwa. Uhlu olufushane futhi olunqala lokuhlukile lwethenjwa kakhulu kunerekhodi elithi azikho izinkinga. Faka lesi simiso kudayari njengesikhathi esiphindaphindwayo nomnikazi onguye, ukuze siphile ngisho nasezinguqukweni zabasebenzi nasemavikini abandayo.

sections.heading: Ukuvala inyanga
paras: Ekupheleni kwenyanga, vala isikhathi. Thumela isifinyezo samalungu, ukulinganiswa kwesitoko nombiko wemali engenayo, ubugcine njengamafayela okufundwa kuphela, uphawule usuku nokuthi ubani oyilungisile. Noma ubani olungisa okuthile ngemuva kwalokho kufanele afake ukulungiswa okunosuku lwenyanga entsha esikhundleni sokubhala kabusha umlando.

Yenza ukuthi omunye umuntu ahlole. Ukwehlukanisa imisebenzi kubalulekile ngisho neklabhu encane: umuntu obala isitoko akufanele abe yedwa ovuma umehluko, futhi umuntu ongenisa imali ebhange akufanele abe yedwa ayivumelanisa.

sections.heading: Ubufakazi okufanele ukwazi ukubukhiqiza
paras: Gcina ifolda, eyephepha noma yedijithali, yenyanga ngayinye: izicelo ezisayiniwe, amarekhodi okwamukelwa kwemithetho, amashiti okubala isitoko, amaphepha okulethwa abaphakeli, imibiko yokuhlalisana kwe-terminal, izitatimende zasebhange nelogi yokuhlukile. Qamba amafayela ngokuhambisana ukuze ahleleke ngosuku.

Amasistimu ayasiza ngokurekhoda isikhathi namagama abasebenzisi ngokuzenzakalelayo, kodwa umkhuba yiwo obalulekile. Buyekeza izikhathi zakho zokugcina ngokweseluleko se-accountant yakho nemithetho yamarekhodi entela ngokwejwayelekile, bese uvuma inqubo eyodwa yokubhubhisa.

sections.heading: Izindawo ezibuthaka ezivamile okufanele uzibheke
paras: Izindawo ezibuthaka ezivamile yilezi: ukulungiswa okungabhalwanga phansi, ukungena kwabaningi ngokufanayo, ukulungisa okubhalwe ngesandla ngaphandle kwamagama okuqala, namafayela agcinwe kumafolda angasese. Ngalunye lenza kube nzima ukufakazela ukuthi ubani wenze ini. Zilungise ngesinye ngesinye, uqale ngokungena kwabaningi nokulungisa okungachazwanga. Noma yisiphi isimiso osamukelayo, siphathe sibe lula ngokwanele ukuze siphile ngesikhathi esimatasa, ngoba isimiso esilula esenziwa njalo ngeviki siwina esikhulu esilahlwa ngemuva kwenyanga.

Qeda ikota ngayinye ngokuzihlola okufushane: khetha amarekhodi amahlanu ngokungahleliwe bese uwalandela ngayinye eya emthonjeni wawo. Phawula lokho okutholile, lungisa inqubo hhayi irekhodi ngalinye, bese wabelana ngesifundo nabasebenzi ukuze igebe elifanayo lingabuyi. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Ukulungiselela Ukuvakashelwa Ngumlawuli: Uhlu Lokuhlola Amarekhodi Wamakilabhu Angasese
description: Uhlu oluthulile nolusebenzayo lwamakilabhu angasese aseNingizimu Afrika alungiselela amarekhodi ukuvakashelwa yigunya: ukuhlela, ukuphendula nokugwema.

sections.heading: Qala ngemibandela yelayisense noma ye-permit yakho
paras: Ngaphambi kokuvakashelwa kunoma yikuphi, kufanele ukwazi ukusho ekhasini elilodwa ukuthi yiphi imibandela esebenza eklabhwini yakho nokuthi ubufakazi bomunye nomunye busekuphi. Imibandela eqondile incike ezinhlelweni zakho nasegunyeni elibhekene nawe, ngakho ungathembi amahemuhemu avela kwamanye amakilabhu. Cela umeluleki wakho noma ummeli wasendaweni afinyezo ngokubhaliwe, bese ulifaka kufayela lakho lokulandela imithetho.

Guqula umbandela ngamunye ube ukulawula ngolimi olulula: lokho esikwenzayo, ubani okwenzayo, kangaki nokuthi irekhodi lisekuphi. Lapho umbandela ungacacile, rekhoda umbuzo nempendulo oyitholile esikhundleni sokuqagela.

sections.heading: Hlela ubufakazi ngezihloko
paras: Hlanganisa amadokhumenti ngaphansi kwamarekhodi amalungu, amarekhodi esitoko nokunyakaza, amarekhodi ezezimali, amarekhodi abasebenzi nezinqubomgomo. Ngaphansi kwamarekhodi amalungu, faka irejista, izicelo nokwamukelwa kwemithetho. Ngaphansi kwesitoko, faka amashiti okubala, ukulungiswa namaphepha abaphakeli. Ngaphansi kwezezimali, faka imibiko ye-till, ukuhlalisana kwe-terminal kanye nokufakwa kwe-VAT noma kwentela okuphathwa yi-accountant yakho.

Yenza inkomba phambili ebhala ngalinye idokhumenti, ububanzi bosuku lwayo nendawo yalo. Abahloli bayayithokozela inkomba ecacile, futhi lo msebenzi ubonisa amagebe ongawalungisa ngaphambi kokuba kubuze noma ubani. Gcina ikhophi kagesi neyephepha yenkomba, ngoba ukucisha kukagesi noma ibhethri eliphelile akufanele kukuvimbele ukukhombisa amarekhodi akho. Buyekeza inkomba noma kuphi lapho kwethulwa uhlobo olusha ledokhumenti, bese urekhoda usuku lokubuyekeza ngalunye.

sections.heading: Ukuthi ubani ukhuluma nokuthi kanjani
paras: Qoka othintwayo oyinhloko oyedwa nonsiza oyedwa. Kufanele bazi ukuthi yonke into isekuphi, baqonde izinqubomgomo, futhi baphendule kuphela lokho okubuzwayo. Abasebenzi kufanele batshelwe ukuthi izivakashi zamukelwa ngenhlonipho, zicelwe isazisi, bese ziyiswa kothintwayo oqokiwe.

Zilolonge ukuvakasha kanye ngonyaka ngokuhamba ngokufushane okuzenzisayo. Khetha usuku ngokungahleliwe ubone ukuthi kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani ukukhiqiza izinguquko zamalungu, ukunyakaza kwesitoko nokuvumelanisa kwemali kwalolo suku. Ukulinganisa isikhathi kubonisa ukuthi ukufayila kwakho kusebenza ngempela yini.

sections.heading: Ukulungisa amagebe ngaphandle kokubhala kabusha umlando
paras: Uma uthola igebe, liphawule, lungisa kusukela manje bese ubhala phansi isenzo sokulungisa nosuku. Ungalibuyisi emuva noma ushintshe amarekhodi akhona ukufihla iphutha. Isistimu egcina umkhondo we-audit, njenge-Budify, ingabonisa ukuthi okufakiwe kwenziwe nini nangubani, nokuvikela abaqhubi abathembekile.

Gcina irejista emfushane yezenzo zokulungisa: udaba, imbangela, ukulungiswa, umnikazi, usuku lokuvalwa. Libuyekeze ezingeni lekomidi njalo ngekota. Engeza ukuhlola okusheshayo ngaphambi kokuvakasha: qinisekisa ukuthi ifayela lokulandela imithetho lisha, izitifiketi nama-permit abonisiwe lapho kudingeka, izinsiza zisebenza, nokuthi abasebenzi bayamazi othintwayo. Iklabhu ethule futhi ehlelekile yenza umbono omuhle futhi ithola izinkinga ngaphambi kokuba abanye bazithole.

sections.heading: Ngemuva kokuvakasha
paras: Uma ukuvakasha sekuphelile, bhala inothi elifushane ngenkathi inkumbulo isasha: ukuthi ngubani oye wabakhona, yini ebuziwe, yimaphi amadokhumenti anikeziwe, nanoma yisiphi isithembiso sokulandelela. Rekhoda isibophezelo ngasinye kudayari ngosuku nomnikazi.

Yabelana ngezifundo nekomidi bese ubuyekeza izinqubo lapho ukuvakasha kubonise ubuthakathaka. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, irekhodi elifushane lokubuyekezwa ngakunye lakha umlando othembekile wokulandela imithetho obonisa ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Ukubalwa Kwesitoko Neklabhu Nokulawula Umehluko Ngamarandi
description: Indlela amakilabhu angasese amalungu aseNingizimu Afrika angabala ngayo isitoko, aphenye umehluko futhi alinganise ngamarandi ngaphandle kokuqagela.

sections.heading: Kungani ukubalwa kuphambuka nokuthi kubiza malini
paras: Wonke amakilabhu agcina isitoko abona umehluko phakathi kwesistimu neshelufu. Izimbangela ngokuvamile zijwayelekile: into ehanjiswe ingarekhodiwe, ukudideka kweyunithi yokulinganisa, into eyonakele engasuswanga, noma iphutha lokufaka idatha. Uma kushiywa, amagebe amancane ayanda enze amabhuku angethembeki. Amakilabhu amaningi futhi agcina uhlu oluncane lwemigqa enobungozi obukhulu noma enenani eliphezulu ebalwa kaningi kunabanye.

Izindleko azimali kuphela. Umehluko ongachazwanga uthulula ukuzethemba, wenza umbiko wezindleko ube yize futhi, lapho imibandela yakho idinga amarekhodi esitoko aqondile, ungadala ubungozi bangempela. Isimiso esijwayelekile sokubala siyi-inshuwalense eshibhile.

sections.heading: Ukuklama ukubalwa
paras: Hlukanisa isitoko sibe yizindawo bese ubala ngokulandelana okuqinile. Sebenzisa ukubala okungabonakali: umbali urekhoda lokho akubonayo engazi inani lesistimu. Omunye umuntu ubala kabusha noma yimuphi umugqa lapho ukubala kokuqala kwehluka kusistimu ngaphezu kwesilinganiso sakho esivunyelwe, isibonelo iyunithi eyodwa noma amaphesenti amabili. Vumelana ngesilinganiso ngokubhaliwe ukuze ababali nabavumi basisebenzise ngendlela efanayo.

Bala ngesikhathi esifanayo njalo ngeviki emigqeni ehamba ngokushesha nanyanga zonke ohlwini olugcwele. Vimba ukunyakaza ngesikhathi sokubala, noma urekhode isikhathi sokunqamula, ukuze okufunyenwe nokukhishiwe ezungeze leso sikhathi kungabalwa kabili.

sections.heading: Ukuphenya umehluko
paras: Hlola emuva umlando wokunyakaza kwaleyo nto selokhu kwabalwa kahle okokugcina: ukulethwa, ukudlulisela, ukulungisa, ukulahlekelwa nokwenziwa kwamalungu. Imbangela ivame ukuvela ngemizuzu. Qala ngokuhlola iyunithi yokulinganisa, bese ubheka ukudluliselwa okurekhodwe endaweni engalungile. Gcina inothi lezimbangela ezivamile otholayo ukuze ukuqeqeshwa kubhekane nezinkinga zangempela.

Uma kungatholakali mbangela, faka ukulungiswa okubhaliwe okunekhodi yesizathu, igama lomvumi nosuku. Ungabhali phezu kwamanani ngokuqondile. Amakhodi ezizathu afana nokonakele, okuphelelwe yisikhathi, ukubala okungalungile noma okungachazwanga akusiza ubone amaphethini.

sections.heading: Ukulinganisa nokubika
paras: Linganisa isitoko ngezindleko ngamarandi usebenzisa indlela eyodwa ehambisanayo evunyelwene ne-accountant yakho, njengesilinganiso esinesisindo. Bika isitoko sokuvula, okufunyenwe, okukhishiwe, ukulungiswa nesitoko sokuvala inyanga ngayinye, bese ukhombisa umehluko njengephesenti lokuhamba. Gcwalisa umehluko ngamarandi nangephesenti ukuze ikomidi libone isikali.

Setha umkhawulo wekomidi ngaphezu kwawo umehluko kufanele uthunyelwe phezulu. Uhlelo olufana ne-Budify lungathatha ukubala kukhompyutha ephathekayo futhi luvale ukulungiswa okuvunyiwe, kodwa ukubuyekeza kuhlala kuwumsebenzi womuntu.

sections.heading: Ukuqeqesha ithimba
paras: Ukubala kuhle njengabantu abakwenzayo kuphela. Nikeza abasebenzi abasha ukuhamba okufushane: ukufunda ishiti lokubala, ukuphatha amayunithi okulinganisa, ukwenza lapho into ibonakala ingalungile nokuthi kungani bengafanele nanini balungise izibalo ukuze ukubala kuvumelane. Gcina amashiti okubala, ukuvunywa kokulungiswa nemibiko yomehluko ndawonye isikhathi ngasinye ukuze indaba yonke ibe sendaweni eyodwa.

Buyekeza imiphumela nethimba ngemuva kokubala okugcwele ngakunye. Dumisa ukubala okuqondile, xoxa ngamaphethini bese uvumelana ngokuthuthuka okukodwa kumjikelezo olandelayo. Ezinyangeni ezimbalwa, umkhuba womehluko kufanele uzinze. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Amarekhodi Ebhishi Nelothi: Ukulandelela Kwamakilabhu Amalungu aseNingizimu Afrika
description: Indlela yokugcina amarekhodi ebhishi nelothi esitokweni seklabhu yangasese: ukwamukela, amalebula, ukunyakaza, ukuphelelwa nemikhondo yamaphepha.

sections.heading: Umsebenzi werekhodi lebhishi
paras: Irekhodi lebhishi noma lelothi liyabophelela inani lesitoko emthonjeni waso nasohambweni lwaso: ubani oluletheyo, lufike nini, yimaphi amadokhumenti afike nalo nokuthi iyunithi ngayinye iye kuphi ngemuva. Likusiza uphendule imibuzo ngokushesha, njengokuthi yiluphi ulethwa oluvela kulo iyunithi ethile.

Eklabhwini yangasese, lokhu kuwumkhuba wamarekhodi, hhayi owokukhangisa. Inhloso ukufakazela ukuthi lokho okugcinayo kuyabalwa, kusukela ekwamukelweni kuya ekunyakazeni kokugcina, nokuthi akukho okubonakala noma okunyamalala ngaphandle komkhondo. Kuyasiza nalapho umphakeli ebuza ngokulethwa, ngoba ungakhombisa ngqo ukuthi yini eyamukelwa nokuthi yini ekhishiwe selokhu.

sections.heading: Inqubo yokwamukela
paras: Ekwamukelweni, abantu ababili bahlola ukulethwa bekuqhathanisa namaphepha: incazelo, inani, isimo nanoma yimaphi amadokhumenti omphakeli adingwa yimibandela yakho. Rekhoda umphakeli, inombolo yenothi lokulethwa, usuku nesikhathi, bese unikeza inombolo yebhishi yangaphakathi evela kuwo wonke amalebula nokufakiwe kwesistimu.

Beka eceleni noma yini engavumelani. Indawo emfushane yokubamba enethegi elibonakalayo ivimbela izinto ezinokungabaza ukuthi zingene esitokweni esijwayelekile. Rekhoda ukungafani, thatha isithombe lapho kusiza, bese wazisa umphakeli ngokubhaliwe ngalolo suku.

sections.heading: Ukunyakaza nokubhalela amalebula
paras: Ukudluliselwa ngakunye phakathi kwesiphephelo, indawo yokusebenza nezindawo ezibhekene namalungu kufanele kudale irekhodi lokunyakaza elinenombolo yebhishi, inani, kusuka, kuya, isikhathi nomsebenzisi. Amalebula kufanele ashicilelwe kusistimu, hhayi abhalwe ngesandla, ukugwema izinombolo ezishintshene.

Yenza uhlolo lokulandelela lwenyanga ngenyanga: khetha amabhishi amathathu ngokungahleliwe bese uwalandela kusukela ekwamukelweni kuze kube yindawo yamanje noma ukukhishwa kokugcina. Uma amanani engavumelani, phenya ngokushesha bese uphawula okutholile kulogi yakho yokuhlukile. Lapho iyunithi ihlukaniswa ibe amanani amancane, nikeza ingxenye ngayinye inkomba yengane ehlobene nebhishi lokuqala ukuze imithamo ibe isahlangana. Rekhoda umuntu owenze ukuhlukanisa nosuku, bese uvumelanisa izingxenye nokugcwele ekubaleni okulandelayo.

sections.heading: Ukuphelelwa yisikhathi, ukulahlwa nokugcinwa
paras: Lapho izinto zinempilo yeshelufu, landelela izinsuku zokuphelelwa yisikhathi ngebhishi bese ubuyekeza uhlu lwezifushane njalo ngeviki. Ukulahlwa kufanele kubonwe ofakazi, kubhalwe phansi futhi kubonakale kusistimu kunekhodi yesizathu.

Gcina amarekhodi ebhishi isikhathi esicelwe i-accountant yakho nommeli wakho. Uhlelo olufana ne-Budify lungagcina izinombolo zebhishi nomlando wokunyakaza endaweni eyodwa, okwenza uhlolo lwenyanga ngenyanga lube lula. Qoka onsiza enqubweni yokulandelela ukuze amarekhodi aphelele ngesikhathi sikaphumule noma ukugula, bese uqinisekisa ukuthi unsiza uqeqeshiwe ezinyathelweni zokwamukela nokubhalela amalebula.

sections.heading: Amacebo asebenzayo wamathimba amancane
paras: Amathimba amancane angakwenza ukulandelela kusebenze ngokunciphisa inani lezindawo zokugcina nokunikeza ngayinye ikhodi ecacile. Izindawo ezimbalwa zisho ukunyakaza okumbalwa okufanele kurekhodwe nokungadideki okuncane.

Hamba nenqubo nomuntu ngamunye osaqala, uyihlole nangezikhathi ezimatasa, ngoba izindlela ezimfushane zivame ukuvela ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Gcina umhlahlandlela oyikhasi elilodwa olamineyithiwe endaweni yokwamukela ukuze izinyathelo zihlale zisesandleni. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Amakhadi Amalungu Nokungena Emnyango Emakilabhwini Angasese aseNingizimu Afrika
description: Ukukhetha nokuphatha amakhadi amalungu eklabhu yangasese yaseNingizimu Afrika: izinhlobo zamakhadi, amarekhodi, amakhadi alahlekile nokuhlolwa emnyango.

sections.heading: Okufanele ikhadi lelungu likwenze
paras: Ikhadi lelungu liwubufakazi bokuthi umuntu useqinisweni lerejista yakho futhi umi kahle, akukho okunye. Kufanele lilethe inombolo yelungu nendlela yokuqinisekisa isimo emnyango, noma ibe inombolo eshicilelwe, ikhodi ye-QR noma i-chip. Ikhadi uqobo kufanele ligcine ulwazi lomuntu siqu oluncane kakhulu.

Ukuqinisekisa kufanele kuhlale kwenzeka kurejista ephilayo. Ikhadi elibonisa igama nesithombe kodwa elingenakuhlolwa ngokuqhathanisa nesimo samanje lidala izinkinga lapho amalungu emiswa noma ephelelwa. Linganisa kusenesikhathi ukuthi ikhadi lizosetshenziselwa yini nezinye izinsizakalo zamalungu, ngoba ukusetshenziswa okwengeziwe kwandisa okugcinwayo nokuthi ubani odinga ukufinyelela.

sections.heading: Ukuqhathaniswa kwezinhlobo zamakhadi
paras: Amakhadi ephepha ashicilelwe ashibhile kodwa alula ukukopisha. Amakhadi epulasitiki anenombolo eshicilelwe nesithombe aqinile kakhulu. Amakhodi e-QR angabonisa efonini noma ashicilelwe, futhi ahlolwa ngokuskena ngokuqhathanisa nerejista. Amakhadi e-chip noma aseduzane afanela amakilabhu anama-turnstile noma izikhiya zikagesi.

Cabanga ngezimo zakho zangempela: izindawo zaseNingizimu Afrika zivame ukuba nedatha yeselula engazinzile, ngakho ukuskena kwe-QR okuncike ekuxhumekeni bukhoma kungehluleka emnyango. Khetha izindlela ezikwazi ukuqinisekisa ngaphandle kokuxhumeka ngokuqhathanisa nohlu olusanda kuvunyelaniswa.

sections.heading: Ukukhishwa, ukushintshwa nokukhanselwa
paras: Gcina ilogi yokukhishwa kwamakhadi: inombolo yekhadi, inombolo yelungu, usuku lokukhishwa, isisebenzi esikhishile nosuku lokubuyiswa noma lokukhanselwa. Ikhadi elilahlekile kufanele likhanselwe ngokushesha kurejista ukuze lingasetshenziswa, bese kukhishwa elinye elinenombolo entsha ngemuva kokuqinisekiswa kobuwena.

Phoqa imali yokushintsha kuphela uma imithetho yakho ikuvumela, bese uyirekhoda kahle emibikweni yakho yemali engenayo. Cisha amakhadi amalungu asishiyile nalawo amisiwe ngosuku olufanayo lapho isimo sishintsha.

sections.heading: Isimiso semnyango
paras: Qeqesha abasebenzi bemnyango ukuhlola izinto ezintathu: ikhadi lisebenza, umuntu uyafana nesithombe noma esinye isazisi esivunyelwe, nokuthi isimo siyabonisa ukuthi uyasebenza. Noma yini enye iya kumphathi, hhayi ekuxoxisaneni emnyango.

Buyekeza ilogi yokungena njalo ngeviki ukuthola amaphethini afana nokuskena okuhlulekile okuphindaphindwayo noma ikhadi elilodwa elisetshenziswa ngezikhathi ezingajwayelekile. Uhlelo olufana ne-Budify lungarekhoda ukuhlola ngakunye nesikhathi, kodwa iklabhu isadinga ukunquma ukuthi izothatha muphi umsebenzi. Gcina isitoko sezipele samakhadi angenalutho esikhwameni esikhiyiwe futhi uwabale njalo ngenyanga ngokuqhathanisa nelogi yokukhishwa, ngoba amakhadi angenalutho alahlekile iyindlela elula yokuvumela amakhadi angarekhodiwe ukuthi ahambe.

sections.heading: Ukubuyekeza uhlelo lwamakhadi
paras: Njalo ezinyangeni eziyisithupha, qhathanisa amakhadi akhishiwe namalungu asebenzayo, bese uphenya noma yikuphi ikhadi elimakwe njengelisebenzayo elingelelungu elisishiyile noma eliphelelwe. Hlola ukuthi izithombe zisafana namalungu, bese uceba izithombe ezintsha lapho zingasafani. Buyekeza ukukhetha kwakho ubuchwepheshe bamakhadi eminyakeni embalwa ngayinye, njengoba izindleko nokwethembeka kushintsha.

Bika kukomidi ngamakhadi alahlekile, ukuskena okuhlulekile nanoma yiziphi izinhlelo zokusebenzisa amakhadi akhanseliwe. Uma udaba olufanayo luqhubeka, lungisa inqubo noma ubuchwepheshe esikhundleni sokuncika kubasebenzi ukuze babuyisele. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Ukwamukelwa Kwamalungu: Izicelo Namarekhodi Obuwena Emakilabhwini
description: Ukugeleza kokwamukelwa kwamalungu eklabhu yangasese yaseNingizimu Afrika: amafomu, ukuhlolwa kobuwena, ukwamukela imithetho namarekhodi okuvuma.

sections.heading: Kungani amarekhodi okwamukelwa ebalulekile
paras: Ihora lokuqala lobulungu liveza izinga lakho konke okulandelayo. Isicelo esiphelele, ubuwena obuqinisekisiwe nokwamukela imithetho okurekhodiwe kusho ukuthi ungakhombisa kamuva ukuthi umuntu waba yilungu kanjani nini nokuthi uvumile ini. Linganisa isikhathi sesigaba ngasinye inyanga eyodwa ukuze ubone lapho izicelo zima khona, bese ugxila esinyathelweni esihamba kancane kakhulu.
Ukweqa izinyathelo ukushesha ngokuhlwa okumatasa kuyimbangela evamile yamarejista ayinkimbinkimbi. Inqubo emfushane ehambisanayo ithatha amaminithi futhi igwema amahora okuhlanza kamuva.

sections.heading: Isicelo
paras: Sebenzisa ifomu eliyisilinganiso elilodwa, lephepha noma ledijithali. Thatha igama elisemthethweni, imininingwane yokuxhumana, usuku lokuzalwa lapho imithetho yakho ikudinga, isigaba selungu esicelwayo negama lomphakamisi noma lomxhasi uma umthethosisekelo wakho ukudinga. Faka isaziso esicacile sochaza ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi lomuntu siqu oluqoqayo, kungani, nokuthi ubani ongalubona. Ungamvumeli umuntu ukuthi angene ngesethembiso sokuthi amaphepha azolandela.
Gcina ifomu lifushane. Inkambu ngayinye eyengeziwe iyinto okufanele uyivikele futhi uyiphikelele. Uma inkambu ingondli isinqumo, umbiko noma isidingo somthetho, ayishiye.

sections.heading: Ukuqinisekisa ubuwena
paras: Lapho imithetho yakho noma imibandela yelayisense idinga ukuqinisekiswa kobuwena, chaza ukuthi ubani onganikeza, yimaphi amadokhumenti amukelekayo nokuthi yini erekhodiwe. Umkhuba omuhle ukurekhoda uhlobo ledokhumenti, ukuthi libonwe, isisebenzi nosuku, kunokugcina amakhophi ngaphandle uma ikhophi idingeka. Hlola amafayela ayishumi njalo ngenyanga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amadokhumenti abonwe futhi arekhodwa kahle.
Uma amakhophi edingeka, wagcine endaweni elinganiselwe bese usetha isikhathi sokugcinwa. Ungawashiyi amadokhumenti obuwena kumafolda abelwanayo noma emizweni yemilayezo.

sections.heading: Ukuvunywa nokusebenza
paras: Dlulisela izicelo kumvumi ongeyena umuntu owazithathile. Rekhoda isinqumo, usuku nesizathu sokunqaba. Kuphela lapho sekuvunyiwe kufanele kukhishwe inombolo yelungu, ikhadi nokungena. Lapho imithetho yakho ikuvumela, setha isikhathi sokuphendula esijwayelekile ukuze abafaka izicelo bazi okufanele bakulindele.

Vala indandatho ngokuthumela umlayezo wokwamukela oqinisekisa isigaba, izimali ezikhokhelwa ngamarandi nendlela yokuvuselela imininingwane. Uhlelo olufana ne-Budify lungagcina isigaba ngasinye njengesimo ukuze lutho lungasebenzi ngaphambi kwesikhathi.

sections.heading: Amaphutha avamile okwamukelwa
paras: Amaphutha avamile yilokhu: ukuvumela ukungena ngaphambi kokuvunywa, ukuthatha imininingwane emaphepheni amancane, nokukhohlwa ukurekhoda ukwamukela imithetho. Elinye ukugcina amakhophi obuwena emagalaji ezithombe ezifonini zomuntu siqu, okudala ingozi yokuvikelwa kwedatha. Buyekeza inqubo ngonyaka nekomidi, uyihlole nemithetho yakho nemibandela yelayisense, bese uvuselela amafomu nezaziso lapho kushintsha noma yini.

Nciphisa amaphutha ngokwenza inqubo yedijithali noma yephepha ibe yiyona kuphela indlela yokungena. Uma othile efuna ukujoyina ngokushesha, impendulo iwukuthi inqubo ishesha, hhayi ukuthi ingeqiwe. Gcina ilogi yokuhlukile uyibuyekeze njalo ngenyanga. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Ukuvuselelwa Kobulungu Namaakhawunti Aphelelwe: Isimiso Somphathi Weklabhu
description: Isimiso esicacile senyanga sokuphatha ukuvuselelwa kobulungu, izikhathi zomusa namaakhawunti aphelelwe emakilabhwini aseNingizimu Afrika.

sections.heading: Misa imithetho ngaphambi kwezinsuku
paras: Izinkinga zokuvuselela zivame ukuvela ekungacaci kwemithetho. Umthethosisekelo wakho noma inqubomgomo yezimali kufanele isho ukuthi ubulungu buphelelwa nini, ukuthi ngabe kunesikhathi somusa, kwenzekani ekungeneni ngaleso sikhathi, nokuthi ukubuyiswa kusebenza kanjani. Zibeke ngamagama alula encwajaneni yamalungu nasezazisweni zokuvuselela. Sebenzisa ulimi olulula bese ugwema ukusabisa; ithoni enenhlonipho igcina ububele.

Vumelana ngamanani ezimali ngamarandi kusenesikhathi sonyaka bese ukhiphisa ikomidi isinqumo emaminithini. Ukushintsha imali phakathi nomjikelezo ngaphandle kwesaziso kuyindlela esheshayo yengxabano. Yabelana ngekhalenda lokuvuselela nomgcini-mabhuku nethimba lasemnyango, ukuze wonke umuntu azi ukuthi yini ekhokhwayo nokuthi kwenzekani ngokulandelayo.

sections.heading: Ikhalenda lokuvuselela lenyanga
paras: Hlela uhlu lobulungu obuphelelwa ezinsukwini ezingu-60 ezizayo. Thumela isaziso sokuqala ezinsukwini ezingu-30 ngaphambi kokuphelelwa, esesibili ezinsukwini ezi-7, nesokugcina ngosuku ngokwalo. Isaziso ngasinye kufanele sisho imali, usuku lokukhokha, indlela yokukhokha nokuthi ubani ongathintwa ngemibuzo. Shicilela uhlelo ebhodini lezaziso leklabhu nasewebhusayithi ukuze lutho lungatholwa ngokumangala.

Rekhoda isaziso ngasinye esithunyelwe. Uma kuvela impikiswano, ungakhombisa ukuthi ilungu lazisiwe ngezinsuku ezithile ngendlela ethile. Lapho amalungu ekhokha ngekhadi noma ngokudluliselwa ebhange, faka inombolo yelungu njengereferensi yenkokhelo ukwenza ukufanisa kube lula, bese ugcina uhlu olufushane lwezinkokhelo ezingazange zifaniswe kuze kuxazululwe.

sections.heading: Ukuphatha ukuphelelwa nokubuyiswa
paras: Ngosuku olulandela ukuphela kwanoma yisiphi isikhathi somusa, shintsha isimo sibe sokuphelelwe bese ucisha ikhadi. Ungasusi irekhodi; ligcine ngokwenqubomgomo yakho yokugcina. Amalungu aphelelwe angase abe nezikweletu ezisele noma afanele ukubuyiswa, ngakho umlando uyabalulekile. Gcina izikhumbuzo zifushane, nesenzo esisodwa esicacile.
Ekubuyisweni, nquma ukuthi inombolo yelungu yokuqala iyabuyiselwa yini noma kukhishwa entsha, bese usebenzisa umthetho ngokuhambisana. Rekhoda usuku nokuthi ubani ovumile.

sections.heading: Ukubika nokuvumelanisa
paras: Bika njalo ngenyanga: amalungu afanele ukukhokha, avuselelwe, aphelelwe nabuyisiwe, nemali engenayo yezimali iqhathaniswa nemibiko yasebhange neye-terminal. Umehluko ukhomba ezinkokhelweni ezingarekhodiwe noma izamukeli ezisetshenziswe ngokungafanele. Yenza ukuhlola okusheshayo kwesampula yamaakhawunti aphelelwe njalo ngenyanga.

Ukuzenzakalelayo kuyasiza. Uhlelo olufana ne-Budify lungaphawula ubulungu obuphelelwa futhi luvimbe amakhadi aphelelwe, kodwa inqubomgomo kufanele isethwe yikomidi lakho. Bheka amazinga okuvuselela unyaka nonyaka. Ukwehla okungazelelwe kungase kukhombise inkinga yesevisi, ushintsho lwezimali noma igebe lokuxhumana, futhi kufanele kuxoxwe ngakho ezingeni lekomidi ngaphambi kokuba kube yinkambiso.

sections.heading: Ukuphatha izingxabano
paras: Lapho ilungu liphikisa ukuphelelwa, buyekeza izaziso ezithunyelwe, amarekhodi enkokhelo nemithetho. Uma iklabhu ibe nephutha, yilungise ngokushesha, rekhoda isizathu bese ubonga ilungu ngokukuphakamisa. Gcina inqubo ebhaliwe ilula ngokwanele ukuze umphathi omusha ayilandele ngaphandle kosizo.

Uma iklabhu ibilungile, chaza ngokuthula ngokubhekisela enqubomgomweni bese unikeza indlela yokubuyiswa. Rekhoda ingxoxo ukuze ikomidi libone ukuthi udaba lwaxazululwa kanjani. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Ukumelana ne-Load-Shedding Kumasistimu Eklabhu Ye-till Namalungu
description: Gcina i-till, ukungena kwamalungu namarekhodi esitoko kusebenza ngesikhathi se-load-shedding: ugesi wesipele, ukusebenza ungaxhumekile nokululama.

sections.heading: Hlela ukucisha, hhayi uhlelo kuphela
paras: Amashejuli e-load-shedding ayasiza, kodwa ukucisha kukagesi kufika nangaphandle kwesaziso ngenxa yamaphutha nokweba izintambo. Uhlelo lokuqhubeka kweklabhu kufanele luthathe ukuthi ngesinye isikhathi ugesi nokuxhumeka kuzohluleka ndawonye ngesikhathi esimatasa, nokuthi abasebenzi kufanele bazi ngqo okufanele bakwenze.

Bhala inqubo yekhasi elilodwa yokucisha: ubani onquma ukuya esimeni sesipele, yini erekhodwa ngesandla nokuthi uzosebenza isikhathi esingakanani ngaphambi kokuvala ngokuphepha. Yishicilele bese uyigcina eduze kwetafula eliyinhloko. Yabelana ngohlelo nomsebenzi ngamunye bese ulifaka ekwamukelweni kwabasha, ukuze kungabikho oqagelayo lapho amalambu ecisha.

sections.heading: Izisekelo zikagesi wesipele
paras: Qala ngezidingo: idivayisi ye-till, i-router, i-terminal yokukhokha ngekhadi, isishicilelo samalebula nezinsiza zasemnyango. I-UPS encane ibagcina ziphila ngaphansi kokuphazamiseka okufushane, kuyilapho i-inverter nebhethri kumboza ukucisha okude. Linganisa ugesi wesipele ngokuhlanganisa ama-watt ezinto ezibalulekile bese wengeza umkhawulo wokuphepha.
Kuhlole. Cisha ugesi omkhulu njalo ngenyanga ubone ukuthi izinsiza zihlala isikhathi esingakanani ngempela. Shintsha amabhethri aguga ngohlelo bese ugcina irekhodi lokuhlolwa nezinsuku.

sections.heading: Ukusebenza ngaphandle kokuxhumeka nesipele sesandla
paras: Khetha amasistimu aqhubeka nokurekhoda ama-transaction nokuhlola kwamalungu endaweni bese evumelanisa lapho ukuxhumeka kubuya. Hlola ukuthi isistimu ingakwenza futhi ayikwenzi ngaphandle kokuxhumeka: isibonelo, ingakwazi yini ukuqinisekisa ikhadi lelungu ngokuqhathanisa nohlu olugciniwe, futhi ingabhekisa ukunyakaza kwesitoko emgqeni?

Gcina ilogi yesandla eshicilelwe kusengaphambili enamakhasi anezinombolo, esikhathini sokwenziwa kwama-transaction, inombolo yelungu, inani namagama okuqala. Amakhasi anezinombolo enza ukuthatha nokubuyekeza kamuva kube lula. Hlola ukuthi amathebulethi nezingcingo ezisetshenziselwa ukungena ziyashajwa ekuqaleni kwe-shift ngayinye, bese ugcina i-power bank ebhedizwe esiteshini ngasinye njengesendlalelo sesibili.

sections.heading: Ukululama ugesi usubuyile
paras: Uma ugesi ubuya, ungashesheli. Qinisekisa ukuthi idivayisi ivumelanisile, qhathanisa ilogi engaxhumekile namarekhodi esistimu, bese ufaka noma yimaphi amagebe ngokulandelana okwenzeke ngakho. Vumelanisa amabhishi e-terminal yekhadi ngokuhlukile, ngoba ama-terminal angahlalisana ngohlelo lwawo.

Rekhoda isigameko ngasinye kulogi yokucisha: ukuqala, ukuphela, umthelela, izenzo nokulandelela. Amaphethini azokufakazela ukutshalwa kwemali okwengeziwe. Uhlelo olufana ne-Budify olusebenza ngaphandle kokuxhumeka lungancisha umsebenzi wesandla, kodwa isimiso sakho yisona esivikela amarekhodi akho.

sections.heading: Ukuqeqesha nokuzilolonga
paras: Yenza ukuzilolonga okufushane kokucisha ngekota ngayinye. Tshela abasebenzi ukuthi kuwuhlolo, ncisha ugesi endaweni ye-till bese ubona ukuthi balandela inqubo ebhaliwe yini. Linganisa isikhathi esithatha ukushintshela emalogini esandla nokuthi ithimba libuyela kanjani kusistimu ngokushelelayo. Gcina ikhophi yeshejuli kamasipala noma yenkampani kagesi yendawo yakho lapho abasebenzi bengayibona, kodwa ayiphathe njengomhlahlandlela hhayi isiqinisekiso.

Xoxa ngemuva kwalokho bese ubuyekeza inqubo. Gcina amabhethri ezipele, amathoshi nama-power bank ebhokisini elinelebula, bese uwahlola ngesikhathi esifanayo. Ukulungiselela kushibhile uma kuqhathaniswa nokuhlwa okuxakile. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Ukuxhumeka Kwe-Wi-Fi Nedatha Yeselula Ezindaweni Zamakilabhu aseNingizimu Afrika
description: Ukuhlela inethiwekhi kumakilabhu angasese aseNingizimu Afrika: ukwakheka kwe-Wi-Fi, i-LTE yesipele, izindleko zedatha nokwenza lapho ukuxhumeka kuphela.

sections.heading: Yazi ukuxhumeka kwakho kwangempela
paras: Ngaphambi kokukhetha izinsiza, linganisa lokho onakho. Hlola isivinini sokulanda, sokulayisha nesokulinda ku-till, emnyango nasezindaweni zokugcina ngezikhathi ezimatasa nezithulile. Izindawo eziningi zithola ukuthi uphawu luqinile eduze kwe-router kodwa lubuthaka lapho abasebenzi besebenza ngempela.

Rekhoda imiphumela epulani elilula phansi. Lokhu kuyisisekelo okulinganiswa ngaso konke ukuthuthuka. Phinda ukuhlola ngemuva kwanoma yikuphi ukuvuselelwa, ngoba izindonga ezintsha, amashelufu noma izinsiza kungashintsha ukumbozwa ngezindlela ongazilindele.

sections.heading: Ukwakheka nezinsiza
paras: Beka amaphoyinti okufinyelela maphakathi futhi, uma indawo inkulu noma inezindonga eziminyene, engeza elinye elixhunywe ngekhebuli esikhundleni sokuncika kuzikhulisi. Amanethiwekhi ahlukene wamadivayisi abasebenzi, ama-terminal okukhokha nokusetshenziswa yizivakashi agcina ithrafikhi ebucayi kude nabasebenzisi abajwayelekile.

Sebenzisa amaphasiwedi anengqondo, awashintshe lapho abasebenzi behamba, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi i-firmware ye-router ibuyekeziwe. Bhalela amakhebuli amalebula futhi ugcine umdwebo olula ukuze noma ubani akwazi ukuxazulula izinkinga. Gwema ukubeka ama-router phansi noma ngaphakathi kwezikhwama, ngoba uphawu luyahlupheka. Awafake phezulu futhi kude nensimbi, bese unikeza iphoyinti lokufinyelela ngalinye ilebula elihambisana nomdwebo wakho ukuze amaphutha alandelelwe ngokushesha.

sections.heading: Isipele nezindleko zedatha
paras: Uma i-fibre noma i-fixed wireless ihluleka, i-router ye-LTE ene-SIM yedatha ingathatha indawo ngokuzenzakalelayo. Khetha uhlelo ledatha lebhizinisi bese ulandelela ukusetshenziswa, ngoba izibuyekezo zangemuva zingasebenzisa okungaphezu kokulindelekile.
Qala ngethrafikhi ebalulekile: ukuvumelanisa ama-transaction, ama-terminal ekhadi nokuqinisekiswa kwamalungu. Vimba ukusakaza namalanda amakhulu kunethiwekhi yebhizinisi ngamahora okuvula.

sections.heading: Ukuklama ukuhluleka kokuxhumeka
paras: Ngisho namanethiwekhi amahle ayanqamuka. Qiniseka ukuthi izinhlelo ze-till nokungena zingasebenza ngaphandle kokuxhumeka futhi zivumelanise kamuva, nokuthi ama-terminal ekhadi angasebenzisa ukuxhumeka kwawo kweselula uma kudingeka. Ungenzi i-shift yonke incike ekuxhumekeni okukodwa.

Hlola isipele njalo ngekota ngokukhipha ucingo oluyinhloko ubhale okwenzekayo. Isistimu efana ne-Budify eklanyelwe ukuxhumeka okuphazamisekayo izolayisha amarekhodi emgqeni, kodwa kufanele uqinisekise ukuziphatha endaweni yakho. Gcina izithombe zesikrini noma amanothi ezilungiselelo zedivayisi ngayinye, ukuze izinsiza zokushintsha zilungiselelwe ngemizuzu esikhundleni samahora.

sections.heading: Ukuphepha nokunakekela
paras: Gcina irejista emfushane yezinsiza zenethiwekhi: imodeli, indawo, usuku lwe-firmware nomxhumanisi womphathi. Shintsha amaphasiwedi okuzenzakalelayo, cisha izici ongazisebenzisi bese ukhawulela ukuthi ubani ongashintsha izilungiselelo ze-router. Ekugcineni, vumelana ngokubuyekezwa kwezindleko kwenyanga ngenyanga kwe-fibre, idatha yeselula nokuqashwa kwezinsiza ngamarandi, uqhathanise lokho okukhokhayo nalokho okusebenzisayo ngempela, bese uphawula ukucisha ngezinsuku ukuze ukuphakamise kubahlinzeki ngokungokoqobo.

Buyekeza ukuthi ubani oxhumekile njalo ngenyanga bese ususa amadivayisi ongawazi. Bhala phansi umdwebo wenethiwekhi yakho, imininingwane ye-SIM nezinombolo zosizo zomhlinzeki endaweni eyodwa ukuze noma ubani osesikhundleni abuyisele isevisi ngokushesha. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Ukudlulisela I-shift Nokuvumelanisa I-till Emakilabhwini Amalungu
description: Isimiso sokudlulisela i-shift nokuvumelanisa i-till emakilabhwini aseNingizimu Afrika: ukubala, umehluko, ukusayina namarekhodi amelana nokubuyekezwa.

sections.heading: Kungani ukudlulisela kuyindawo lapho amaphutha ecasha khona
paras: Ukungafani okuningi kwemali nesitoko kuvela ekushintsheni kwe-shift, ngoba yilapho umthwalo uphuma komunye umuntu uye komunye. Ukudlulisela okuhlelekile kudala isikhathi esicacile lapho amanani evunyelwana khona futhi ukuziphendulela kumiswa. Zungezisa umuntu obalayo nomuntu ohlolayo ukuze kungabikho oyedwa njalo nemali.

Ngaphandle kwalokho, akekho ongasho ukuthi inkinga ngeyasiphi i-shift, futhi abasebenzi abathembekile bathwala icala lamaphutha abanye. Ukudlulisela okurekhodiwe kusiza nalapho abasebenzi bengekho, ngoba umuntu olandelayo angabona ngqo ukuthi izinto zazimi kanjani.

sections.heading: Uhlu lokuhlola lokudlulisela
paras: Abasebenzi abaphumayo nabangenayo babala imali yokuqala ndawonye, bayiqhathanise nebhalansi yokuvula yesistimu bese basayina ishidi lokudlulisela. Buyekeza izinto ezivulekile: izicelo zamalungu ezilindile, amaphutha ezinsiza, amanothi esitoko esiphansi nanoma yiziphi izigameko. Shicilela uhlu lokuhlola ekhasini elilodwa bese ugcina ikhophi esayiniwe namarekhodi osuku ngalunye.

Gcina uhlu lokuhlola lufushane ngokwanele ukuze lusetshenziswe njalo. Imigqa eyishumi eyenziwe kahle iyawina emashumi amathathu eqiwe. Uma ukudlulisela kudlulwa ngoba indawo imatasa, kuphawule kulogi yokuhlukile bese uqedela ngokushesha lapho ukushesha kudlula, esikhundleni sokushiya igebe lingarekhodiwe.

sections.heading: Ukuvala i-till
paras: Ekuvaleni, hlela umbiko wesistimu wokuphela kwe-shift ngaphambi kokubala, ukugwema ukuthambekela. Bala imali ngezinhlobo zayo, uqhathanise nenani elilindelekile bese urekhoda noma yimuphi umehluko ngamarandi nesizathu. Yenza ukuhlalisana kwe-terminal yekhadi bese ukufanisa nenani lekhadi lesistimu. Vumelana ngendlela ejwayelekile yokuchaza umehluko ukuze imibiko ihambisane.
Setha isilinganiso somehluko bese uthumela noma yini edlula kuso kumphathi. Ukuntuleka okuncane okuphindaphindwayo ku-till eyodwa noma ku-shift eyodwa nakho kudinga ukunakwa.

sections.heading: Ukufaka ebhange namarekhodi
paras: Faka imali ebhange ngokohlelo oluqinile ngephepha lokufaka elinenombolo nelifayiliwe. Omunye umuntu kufanele aqinisekise inani elikwikhasi. Isifinyezo sosuku, inothi lomehluko nereferensi yokufaka kufanele kugcinwe ndawonye. Gcina izikhwama zokufaka zingenakuthinteka futhi zirekhodiwe.

Buyekeza njalo ngeviki: izibalo eziphelele, umehluko ngesisebenzi nangemisebenzi, nezinto ezingaxazululiwe. Uhlelo olufana ne-Budify lungavala ama-shift avaliwe futhi lukhiphe imibiko, kodwa ukusayina kusengesinyathelo somuntu. Lapho iklabhu incane, umgcini-sikhwama noma ilungu lekomidi lingasebenza njengomuntu wesibili ngokuphindaphindana, okugcina ukulawula kuyindawo ngaphandle kokuqasha abasebenzi abengeziwe.

sections.heading: Ukusebenzisa idatha
paras: Uma amarekhodi okudlulisela eqoqeka, amaphethini ayavela. Umehluko ohlala wehlela ku-shift eyodwa ungase ukhombise inkinga yenqubo kunomuntu, njengesikhathi somnyango esixinene noma ukufakwa kwentengo okudidayo. Buyekeza uhlu lokuhlola kabili ngonyaka nethimba, susa izinyathelo ezingandisi lutho bese wengeza lezo ezigcizelelwe izigameko njengezidingekayo.

Hlinzeka ikomidi ngamanani enyanga bese uvumelana ngokuthuthukisa. Gcina kwakhayo: inhloso yamarekhodi ahlanzekile nokuphatha abasebenzi ngokulinganayo, hhayi ukusola. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: I-VAT Nezimali Zobulungu: Imibuzo Okufanele Abagcini-sikhwama Beklabhu Bayibuze
description: Umhlahlandlela womgcini-sikhwama ngemibuzo ye-VAT nezimali zobulungu emakilabhwini angasese aseNingizimu Afrika: ukubhalisa, ama-invoyisi namarekhodi.

sections.heading: Qala ngesimo sakho
paras: Ukuthi iklabhu ibhalisele i-VAT yini, nokuthi izimali zayo zinakwa kanjani, kuncike ekwakhekeni kwayo, emalini engenayo nasemisebenzini yayo. Iklabhu yangasese yamalungu ingaba inhlangano, inkampani noma enye inhlangano, futhi impendulo iyahlukahluka. Ungakopi indlela yeklabhu enye ngaphandle kokuhlola.

Cela i-accountant yakho ibhale phansi: ukuthi kumele noma ungabhalisa yini, yimiphi imithombo yemali engenayo efakiwe nokuthi yiluphi ubufakazi obulindelwe yi-SARS. Gcina leli nothi kufayela lakho lezezimali bese ulibuyekeza uma imali engenayo noma imisebenzi ishintsha. Khumbula ukuthi imikhawulo nemithetho iyashintsha ngezikhathi ezithile, ngakho hlola isimo samanje nomeluleki wakho unyaka ngamunye esikhundleni sokuncika enkumbulweni.

sections.heading: Ukuhlukanisa imithombo yemali engenayo
paras: Rekhoda umthombo ngamunye wemali engenayo ngaphansi kwekhodi yawo: izimali zokujoyina, izimali zonyaka, amakhadi esikhundleni, imali yemicimbi nanoma yiziphi ezinye izindleko. Ukufaka amakhodi okunembile yikho okuvumela i-accountant yakho ukuthi isebenzise indlela efanele, esikhundleni sokuqagela esilinganisweni esisodwa.

Qiniseka ukuthi isamukeli ngasinye ngamarandi sibonisa ukuthi sasiyini. Izincazelo ezingacacile zidala izinkinga kamuva, ikakhulukazi uma indlela yokuphathwa kwentela yehluka phakathi kwemithombo. Lapho izimali zikhokhwa ngezigaba, rekhoda isibophezelo esigcwele nesigaba ngasinye ngokuhlukile ukuze imali engenayo nezikweletu kulandelelwe ngokunembile.

sections.heading: Ama-invoyisi, izamukeli namanothi ezikweletu
paras: Uma i-VAT isebenza, ama-invoyisi entela kufanele abe nezakhi ezidingwa yimithetho, ongaziqinisekisa nge-accountant yakho. Linganisa amadokhumenti ngokulandelana, ungalokothi ususe, futhi khipha amanothi ezikweletu ukulungisa.

Kumalungu akhokha ngekhadi, qiniseka ukuthi ishidi le-terminal, isamukeli sesistimu nokuhlalisana kwasebhange kungafaniswa. Gcina ubufakazi benkokhelo ukubuyisela imali bese uphawula isizathu kurekhodi.

sections.heading: Ukubika ku-accountant yakho
paras: Nikeza iphakheji yenyanga: imali engenayo ngomthombo, izamukeli namanothi ezikweletu, ukuhlalisana kwe-terminal, izitatimende zasebhange nokuvumelanisa. Faka uhlu lwezinto ezingajwayelekile ezinezincazelo.

Buyekeza ukuthi isistimu yakho ikhiqiza yini ukuthunyelwa ngefomethi i-accountant engayisebenzisa. Uhlelo olufana ne-Budify lungathumela imibiko yemali engenayo ngesigaba, kodwa izinqumo ze-VAT zisala kumeluleki wakho. Yabelana ngekhalenda lezinsuku zokufaka nokukhokha nekomidi, ukuze kungabikho oshaqekile yisikhathi, bese urekhoda ukuthi ubani onesibopho ngalunye.

sections.heading: Ukugcina umkhondo wamaphepha uhlele
paras: Yenza ifolda yezimali yesikhathi sentela ngasinye enama-invoyisi akhishiwe, amanothi ezikweletu, ama-invoyisi abaphakeli, izitatimende zasebhange namaphepha okusebenza e-accountant yakho. Sebenzisa amagama amafayela ahambisanayo afaka usuku nenombolo yedokhumenti. Phatha noma yikuphi ukushintsha esakhiweni sezimali, isevisi entsha noma umthombo omusha wemali engenayo njengesizathu sokubuza umeluleki wakho ukuthi isimo sentela siyashintsha yini, bese urekhoda impendulo. Ukubuyekeza lokhu unyaka ngamunye kushibhile kakhulu kunokulungisa izikhathi eziningana kamuva.

Uma uthola umbuzo ovela egunyeni lentela, phendula ngomeluleki wakho bese unikeza amarekhodi ngokushesha. Ukuba nesimiso senyanga kusho ukuthi awusoze wafuna amadokhumenti ngokuphuthuma. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Ukuvumelanisa Kwe-Terminal Yokukhokha Ngekhadi Emakilabhwini aseNingizimu Afrika
description: Indlela yokuvumelanisa ukuhlalisana kwe-terminal yekhadi ne-till nezitatimende zasebhange, kufaka phakathi izindleko nemigqa engaxhumekile.

sections.heading: Amarekhodi amathathu, iqiniso elilodwa
paras: Inkokhelo ngayinye yekhadi isiza imikhondo emithathu: isamukeli sesistimu, ibhishi le-terminal nokuhlalisana kwasebhange. Ukuvumelanisa kuwukufakazela ukuthi zontathu ziyavumelana, ngemuva kokunaka izindleko nesikhathi. Uma ungakwazi ukukwenza lokhu nsuku zonke noma njalo ngeviki, ukuvala inyanga kuba lula.

Qala ngokuvumelana ngokuthi ubani onesibopho somsebenzi, kuhle kube umuntu ongasebenzisi ama-till. Ishidi elilula lesipredishithi noma imibiko evela kusistimu yeklabhu yakho isanele ekuqaleni, uma nje izinyathelo ezifanayo zilandelwa njalo.

sections.heading: Ukufanisa kwansuku zonke
paras: Ngemuva kokuvala, shicilela noma ulande umbiko webhishi le-terminal bese uqhathanisa isamba nenani lekhadi lesistimu lesikhathi esifanayo. Noma yimuphi umehluko uphenyelwa ngalolo suku: okufakwe ngesandla, ukwenziwa komsebenzi okuhoxisiwe ohlangothini olulodwa kuphela, noma ibhishi elingavalwanga.

Vala amabhishi e-terminal ngesikhathi esimisiwe nsuku zonke ukuze ukuhlalisana kufike ngendlela elindelekile futhi kufane nesikhathi esichaziwe. Gcina amaslipi ephepha nemibiko ye-terminal ndawonye namarekhodi osuku bese uwafayila ngosuku, ngoba yiwona okuqala okubuzwa yi-accountant noma umhlinzeki.

sections.heading: Izindleko, isikhathi nokubuyiswa kwemali
paras: Ukuhlalisana kufika ngemuva kokususa izindleko ngokubambezeleka okuncike kumhlinzeki wakho. Rekhoda imali yonke etholakele, izindleko ngamarandi nokufakwa kwenetha ngokuhlukile ukuze izindleko zibonakale. Yenza uhlelo lwesikhathi ukuze wazi ukuthi yiziphi izinkokhelo ozilindele ngaziphi izinsuku.

Izinkokhelo ezimangalelwayo kufanele zirekhodwe ngosuku, ilungu, inani, isizathu nomphumela. Gcina amarekhodi asekelayo afana nezamukeli namalogi okungena isikhathi esiceliwe ngumhlinzeki wakho ne-accountant. Buyekeza inkontileka yakho ye-terminal kanye ngonyaka, uhlole isakhiwo sezindleko, izikhathi zokuhlalisana nezindleko zanoma yikuphi ukuqashwa, bese ubhala usuku lwesikhathi sokuziswa ukuze ungabanjwa ngokuzenzakalelayo.

sections.heading: Ukuxhumeka nemigqa engaxhumekile
paras: Ama-terminal angagcina ama-transaction lapho ukuxhumeka kunqamuka bese ethumela kamuva, ngakho ama-transaction kungavela ebhisheni elilandelayo. Kuphawule ekuvumelaniseni kwakho esikhundleni sokukuphatha njengephutha.

Buyekeza izitatimende zezindleko unyaka ngamunye bese uqhathanisa abahlinzeki uma izindleko zibaphezulu. Uhlelo olufana ne-Budify lungagcina izibalo zamakhadi ngesikhathi se-shift ngasinye ukusheshisa ukufanisa.

sections.heading: Ukukwenza kube yisimiso
paras: Faka ukuvumelanisa ekhalendeni leviki ngomnikazi onguye nosekela. Sebenzisa isifanekiso esilula esinamakholomu osuku, isamba sesistimu, isamba se-terminal, umehluko, incazelo nokusayina. Lapho kusetshenziswa ama-terminal amaningi, ubhale ngalinye ilebula bese uwavumelanisa ngokuhlukile, ukuze inkinga ilandelwe kudivayisi ethile, endaweni noma ku-shift ngaphandle kokucwaninga ngokuhlangene.

Thumela phezulu umehluko osala uvulekile ngemuva kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa. Ngekota, landelela isilinganiso sesikhathi sokukhuculwa komehluko. Inani elehlayo likhombisa ukuthi inqubo iyasebenza, kuyilapho inani elikhulayo libonisa lapho abasebenzi bedinga ukwesekwa noma ukuhlelwa kudinga ukushintshwa. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Ukuthunyelwa Kwasekupheleni Kwenyanga I-accountant Yakho Ezolisebenzisa Ngempela
description: Okufanele kufakwe kuphakheji yenyanga ye-accountant yakho: imibiko yemali engenayo, yesitoko, yamalungu neyemali yeklabhu yangasese yaseNingizimu Afrika.

sections.heading: Vumelana ngephakheji kanye
paras: Hlala phansi ne-accountant yakho bese uvumelana ngephakheji eyisilinganiso yenyanga: yiziphi izibiko, ngayiphi ifomethi, ngasiphi isikhathi. Uma isivunyelwene, iba isimiso esikhundleni sokuxoxisana ngenyanga ngenyanga. Vumelana ngesikhathi sokugcina esifanele zombili izinhlangothi, njengosuku lwesihlanu lomsebenzi.

Qinisekisa izinhlobo zamafayela, ngoba ama-accountant amaningi akhetha amaspredishithi noma amafayela e-CSV angangeniswa kunezithombe zesikrini noma ama-PDF. Ifolda eyabelwanayo enokufinyelela okukhawulelwe isebenza kahle, uma nje izimvume zibuyekezwa njalo futhi abasebenzi bangaphambilini bayasuswa.

sections.heading: Imibiko eyisisekelo
paras: Iphakheji ejwayelekile ifaka umbiko wemali engenayo ngesigaba ngamarandi, ukuvumelanisa kokuhlalisana kwekhadi, isifinyezo semali yesandla nesasebhange, umbiko wokunyakaza nokulinganiswa kwesitoko, nesifinyezo samalungu esibonisa abajoyine, abasishiyile nezimali ezifanele ukukhokhwa. Engeza uhlu lokulungiswa nokulahlwa nezizathu. Faka izinombolo zamalungu kuphela lapho i-accountant izidinga ngempela.

Gcina amagama ezigaba ehambisana inyanga ngenyanga ukuze ukuqhathanisa kube nomqondo. Lapho isistimu ikuvumela, faka isifinyezo sokunyakaza kwesitoko ngekhodi yesizathu, ngoba ukulungiswa nokulahlwa yikho ama-accountant avame ukukubuza.

sections.heading: Ukuhlola ngaphambi kokuthumela
paras: Qinisekisa ukuthi izibalo ziyavumelana: imali engenayo yesistimu nokufakwa ebhange, ukunyakaza kwesitoko nokulinganiswa, nezimali zamalungu nemali engenayo. Hlola ukuthi isikhathi sivaliwe futhi akukho ukuhlela kwamuva okushintshe amanani. Gcina uhlu olulodwa oluyinhloko lwezincazelo zemibiko ukuze iphakheji ingashintshi ngengozi.

Engeza inothi lekhasi elilodwa lokumboza elibhala izinto ezingajwayelekile nemibuzo evulekile. Longa isikhathi se-accountant futhi libonisa ukuthi iklabhu ibuyekeze amanani ayo. Uma uthola iphutha ngemuva kokuthumela, thumela ifayela elilungisiwe elinenothi elicacile lokuthi kushintshe ini nokuthi kungani, esikhundleni sokushintsha elilandulelayo ngokuthula.

sections.heading: Ukufayila nokugcina
paras: Gcina iphakheji kufolda enosuku, uyimake ifundwe kuphela bese urekhoda ukuthi ubani ayilungisile nokuthi ubani ayivumile. Sebenzisa isakhiwo sefolda esifanayo inyanga ngayinye. Rekhoda ukuthi ubani ovumile iphakheji.

Uhlelo olufana ne-Budify lungakhiqiza lokhu kuthunyelwa, kodwa qinisekisa ukuthi kuvumelana nokulindelwe yi-accountant yakho. Izikhathi zokugcina zamarekhodi ezezimali kufanele ziqinisekiswe ne-accountant yakho.

sections.heading: Ukuthuthukisa iphakheji ngokuhamba kwesikhathi
paras: Ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbalwa, buza i-accountant yakho ukuthi yiyiphi imibuzo ekhona ayibuza. Umbuzo ngamunye ophindaphindwayo uyisihlobo sekholomu entsha, ilebula ecacile noma inothi elengeziwe ekhasini lokumboza. Gcina ilogi emfushane yosuku lokulethwa lwenyanga ngayinye uluqhathanise nesikhathi sokugcina esivunyelwene. Iklabhu ehlala ilethela ngesikhathi ivame ukuthola iseluleko esisheshayo, esishibhile nesiwusizo kakhulu ngokubuyisela.

Buyekeza iphakheji kanye ngonyaka nekomidi bese ulahla noma yini engasetshenziswa muntu. Iphakheji emfushane ehlala ifika ngesikhathi ibaluleke kakhulu kunende efika sekwephuzile. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Izisekelo ze-POPIA Zabaphathi Beklabhu Yangasese Yamalungu
description: Umkhuba jikelele okhumbula i-POPIA emakilabhwini angasese aseNingizimu Afrika: ukuqoqa ulwazi, inhloso, ukuphepha, izicelo zokufinyelela nezigameko.

sections.heading: Kungani amakilabhu egcina idatha ebucayi
paras: Irejista yamalungu iqukethe amagama, imininingwane yokuxhumana futhi imvamisa neyobuwena. ENingizimu Afrika, i-POPIA ilawula ukuthi izinhlangano ziwuphatha kanjani ulwazi lomuntu siqu, futhi amakilabhu awahlukile. I-Information Regulator yigunya elengamela uhlelo.

Lesi sihloko sinikeza imikhuba ejwayelekile yokusebenza, hhayi umbono wezomthetho. Iklabhu yakho kufanele ithole iseluleko ngezibopho zayo ezithile, kufaka phakathi ukuthi kumele yini ibhaliswe umphathi wolwazi. Inhloso akukwesabisa amakomidi kodwa ukwakha imikhuba emincane engaphindaphindwa evikela abantu futhi inciphise ubungozi.

sections.heading: Qoqa kancane, chaza kakhulu
paras: Buyekeza inkambu ngayinye yefomu lakho lokufaka isicelo bese ubuza ukuthi iyadingeka yini. Susa noma yini okuyiyona nje enhle ukuba nayo. Chaza ngamagama alula ukuthi kungani isigaba ngasinye solwazi siqoqwa, ubani asibonayo nokuthi usigcina isikhathi esingakanani.
Gcina irejista emfushane yokucubungula: lokho okugcinayo, lapho kuhlala khona, ubani onokufinyelela, yibaphi abahlinzeki abaluphethe nokuthi lususwa nini.

sections.heading: Ukuphepha ngamagama alula
paras: Vikela irejista ngezilokhu zobuqu, ukufinyelela okuncike emsebenzini, amaphasiwedi aqinile nalapho kungenzeka, ukuqinisekisa ngezinyathelo ezimbili. Ungabelani ngamaakhawunti. Yenza ikhophi yesipele yedatha uhlole ukubuyiselwa. Khiya amafayela ephepha.

Qaphela abahlinzeki: noma yimuphi umhlinzeki wesofthiwe, i-accountant noma inkundla yemilayezo ephatha idatha yamalungu kufanele ibhekwe isivumelwano esibhaliwe esichaza ukuthi iyivikela kanjani leyo datha.

sections.heading: Izicelo nezigameko
paras: Lungiselela inqubo elula yamalungu abuza ukuthi uyini ngawo noma afuna ukulungiswa. Rekhoda isicelo, qinisekisa ubuwena, phendula ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esishiwo bese urekhoda lokho okwenziwe.

Lungiselela nezigameko. Uhlelo lwekhasi elilodwa kufanele lusho ukuthi ubani ophenyayo, ubani owaziswayo nokuthi izinqumo zirekhodwa kanjani. Uhlelo olufana ne-Budify lungakhawulela ukufinyelela futhi lugcine umkhondo we-audit, kodwa inqubomgomo ukusetha kwakho. Khumbula ukuthi amalungu angakhononda ne-Information Regulator, ngakho inqubo yokuphendula ebhaliwe nenenhlonipho isenzuzweni seklabhu uqobo.

sections.heading: Ukwakha umkhuba wokubuyekeza
paras: Faka into yokuvikelwa kwedatha ohlelweni lwekomidi ngekota ngayinye. Buyekeza irejista yokucubungula, noma yiziphi izicelo ezitholiwe, ukushintshwa kwabahlinzeki nanoma yiziphi izigameko noma okuphuzile. Gcina izinto ezibhaliwe zimfushane futhi zisebenzayo: isaziso sobumfihlo sekhasi elilodwa sabafaka izicelo, umhlahlandlela wabasebenzi wekhasi elilodwa nohlu lokuhlola isigameko sekhasi elilodwa ngokuvamile kusebenza kangcono kunenqubomgomo ende engafundwa muntu. Buyekeza zontathu ngonyaka bese urekhoda usuku.

Qeqesha abasebenzi ekwamukelweni futhi unyaka ngamunye emva kwalokho, usebenzisa izibonelo zangempela zeklabhu, njengezithombe zesikrini ezithunyelwe engxoxweni engalungile noma ilaptop eshiywe ingakhiyiwe. Izikhumbuzo ezisebenzayo ziguqula imikhuba kangcono kunezinqubomgomo ezinde. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Amazinga Okufinyelela Kwabasebenzi Nezinhlelo Zokugcina Idatha Yeklabhu
description: Chaza ukuthi ubani obona ini kumasistimu eklabhu yakho, bese usetha uhlelo lokugcina olufanele lwamarekhodi amalungu, esitoko nezezimali eNingizimu Afrika.

sections.heading: Ilungelo elincane ekusebenzeni
paras: Nikeza umuntu ngamunye ukufinyelela okuncane okudingekayo emsebenzini wakhe. Abasebenzi basemnyango badinga ukubona isimo negama; abaphathi badinga imininingwane yokuxhumana; iqembu elincane kuphela elifanele likwazi ukuthumela irejista egcwele noma ukushintsha izimali. Faka abaqashiwe nabasebenzi besikhashana kumathrikisi.

Bhala imethrikisi yokufinyelela yekhasi elilodwa ebhala izikhundla nezimvume, bese uyivumisa ikomidi. Yibuyekeze njalo ngekota. Lapho kungenzeka, xhuma ukubuyekezwa kokufinyelela nekhalenda lekomidi ukuze kungakhohlwa.

sections.heading: Abangenayo, abashintshayo nabahambayo
paras: Lapho umuntu ejoyina, mdalele isilokhu sakhe bese umqeqesha. Lapho eshintsha isikhundla, lungisa izimvume ngokushesha. Lapho ehamba, cisha ukufinyelela ngalo lolo suku, kufaka phakathi amabhokisi eposi abelwanayo, amaqembu emilayezo nesitoreji sefu. Qiniseka ukuthi umuntu ovumela ukufinyelela akayena umuntu okwamukelayo.
Gcina ilogi yezinguquko enezinsuku nabavumi. Ubufakazi bokuthi ukufinyelela kuphethwe ngempela.

sections.heading: Ukwakha uhlelo lokugcina
paras: Bhala uhlobo ngalunye lwerekhodi: izicelo, irejista yamalungu, amalogi amakhadi, amalogi okungena, amarekhodi esitoko, amarekhodi ezezimali ne-CCTV lapho isetshenziswa. Ngalunye, rekhoda inhloso, umnikazi, isikhathi sokugcina nendlela yokulahla. Izikhathi zokugcina kufanele ziqinisekiswe nge-accountant yakho nommeli wakho, ngoba ziyahlukahluka. Gcina uhlu lwamasistimu luphelele, kufaka phakathi i-imeyili nemilayezo.

Lapho unokungabaza, gcina ulwazi lomuntu siqu oluncane isikhathi esifushane, kodwa ungasusi amarekhodi okufanele uwagcine. Phatha ngokucophelela amakhophi esipele, ngoba amakhophi edatha endala angase abe sezindaweni ezingagcwali uhlelo lokugcina. Rekhoda lapho amakhophi esipele egcinwe khona, azogcinwa isikhathi esingakanani nokuthi abhubhiswa kanjani.

sections.heading: Ukulahla nokubuyekeza
paras: Yenza ukulahla unyaka ngamunye. Khiqiza uhlu lwamarekhodi adlule usuku lokugcina, lungiswe, susa noma ugaye ngokuphepha bese urekhoda usuku nendlela. Bhala phansi okuhlukile nokuthi ubani ovumile.
Sebenzisa imikhondo ye-audit ukubuyekeza ukuthi ubani wafinyelela ini. Uhlelo olufana ne-Budify lurekhoda izenzo zabasebenzisi, okusiza ukubona umsebenzi ongajwayelekile.

sections.heading: Ukwenza kunamathele
paras: Izinqubomgomo zisebenza kuphela uma abasebenzi bezazi. Fingqa imethrikisi yokufinyelela nohlelo lokugcina eshidini elilodwa bese uxoxa ngalo ekwamukelweni. Cela abasebenzi baqinisekise ngokubhaliwe ukuthi bayasiqonda isibopho sabo. Cabanga ngokugcina ilogi elula yekhasi elilodwa yokuthunyelwa ngakunye kohlu olugcwele lwamalungu, uphawule ukuthi ubani okucelile, kungani nokuthi ifayela lagcinwa kuphi, bese ulisusa lapho selisebenzile.

Hlola kancane ngekota ngayinye: khetha amaakhawunti ayisihlanu uqinisekise ukuthi avumelana nemethrikisi, bese ukhetha amarekhodi amadala amahlanu uqinisekise ukuthi asemkhawulweni wokugcinwa. Bika imiphumela kukomidi. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Isofthiwe Ekuqala Ngokungaxhumekile: Okushiwo Emisebenzini Yeklabhu
description: Qonda isofthiwe yeklabhu ne-POS eqala ngokungaxhumekile eNingizimu Afrika: isitoreji sasendaweni, ukungqubuzana kokuvumelanisa nokuhlola ngaphambi kokuyikhetha.

sections.heading: Ukuqala ngokungaxhumekile akufani nokukwazi ukusebenza ungaxhumekile
paras: Amanye amasistimu ayayeka ukusebenza lapho ukuxhumeka kuphela futhi anikeza imodi yesimo esiphuthumayo elinganiselwe. Amasistimu aqala ngokungaxhumekile aklanyelwe ukuthi idivayisi yenze umsebenzi wayo endaweni futhi ivumelanise ngemuva. Ezindaweni ezibhekene ne-load-shedding nedatha engazinzile, umehluko mkhulu. Cela izethenjwa ezivela ezindaweni ezinezimo ezifanayo.

Cela abahlinzeki babonise, hhayi nje bachaze. Cisha i-router ngesikhathi sombukiso ubone ukuthi yimiphi imisebenzi esala. Khumbula ukufaka nama-terminal okukhokha ngekhadi ekuhlolweni, ngoba incike ekuxhumekeni kwawo futhi ingase iziphathe ngokuhlukile esistimini esiyinhloko.

sections.heading: Okumele kusebenze ungaxhumekile
paras: Bhala phansi imisebenzi yakho ebalulekile: ukuhlola isimo selungu, ukurekhoda ama-transaction, ukulungisa isitoko, ukuvala i-shift. Kuyo yonke, qinisekisa ukuthi isebenza ngaphandle kokuxhumeka, kurekhodwa kanjani nokuthi ivumelanisa nini. Hlola nokuthi yini engasebenzi ngaphandle kokuxhumeka, njengokuvunywa kwelungu elisha noma ukugunyazwa kwe-terminal yekhadi. Bhala phansi ukuthi yimiphi imisebenzi engatholakali ngaphandle kokuxhumeka bese uchazela abasebenzi ngokufanele.

Qiniseka ukuthi idivayisi ingaphethe ikhophi esanda kwenziwa yohlu lwamalungu nokuthi ubulungu obukhanseliwe bufakiwe uma sebuvumelaniswe. Yenza umhlahlandlela wabasebenzi wekhasi elilodwa obonisa, ngolimi olulula, okufanele kwenziwe lapho idivayisi ibonisa inkomba yokungaxhumekile nokufanele kwenziwe lapho iphinde ixhumeke.

sections.heading: Ukuvumelanisa, ukungqubuzana nobuqotho
paras: Uma amadivayisi amabili eshintsha irekhodi elifanayo engaxhumekile, isistimu idinga umthetho. Buza ukuthi ukungqubuzana kuxazululwa kanjani nokuthi umphumela urekhodwa yini. Esitokweni, ukunyakaza okwengeziwe kuphephile kunokubhala phezu kwamanani. Cela incazelo yokuthi idatha ifihlwa kanjani kudivayisi.
Qinisekisa ukuthi izikhathi ziqhubeka zinembe lapho iwashi ledivayisi liphambuka, nokuthi okuphindiwe akudalwa lapho ukuvumelanisa kuphazamiseka.

sections.heading: Ukuhlolela endaweni yakho
paras: Yenza uhlolo: nqamula ihora eli-1 ngesikhathi esithulile, cubungula umsebenzi ojwayelekile, xhuma kabusha uvumelanise. Qhathanisa izibalo, isitoko namarekhodi amalungu nelogi yesandla. Gcina amanothi okuhlola njengengxenye yamarekhodi akho.
Bhala phansi umphumela bese uqeqesha abasebenzi ngokutholakele. Uhlelo olufana ne-Budify olunesitoreji esiqala endaweni kufanele luphumelele lolu hlolo, kodwa lusebenzise wena uqobo.

sections.heading: Imibuzo okufanele uyibuze umhlinzeki
paras: Buza ukuthi idatha igcinwa kuphi, ivumelaniswa kangaki, igcinwa kanjani ikhophi yesipele nokuthi ungakuthumela kanjani konke uma uhamba. Buza ukuthi kwenzekani uma idivayisi ilahleka, nokuthi ingakhiywa noma ikhishwe ukude yini. Gcina irekhodi lohlolo lwakho, izimpendulo zomhlinzeki nesinqumo esithathiwe. Uma kamuva ushintsha amasistimu noma wengeza izindawo, leli rekhodi lifinyeza ukuhlolwa okulandelayo futhi livikele ikomidi uma kuphakama imibuzo.

Cela incazelo ebhaliwe yezinhlelo zokusekela nokuphendula izigameko, bese uthola ukuthi umhlinzeki unolwazi nabaqhubi abajabulele ukucisha kukagesi njalo yini. Qhathanisa izimpendulo phakathi kwabahlinzeki ethebuleni elilula. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Ukukhetha Isofthiwe Yokuphatha Iklabhu: Uhlu Lokuhlola Lwaseningizimu Afrika
description: Uhlu lokuhlola lokukhetha isofthiwe yeklabhu ne-POS eNingizimu Afrika: amarekhodi, ukusebenza ungaxhumekile, ukusekelwa, idatha nezindleko ngamarandi.

sections.heading: Chaza umsebenzi kuqala
paras: Bhala uhlu lwalokho isistimu okufanele ikwenze: irejista yamalungu, amakhadi nokungena, isitoko, i-till, imibiko nokuthunyelwa. Zihlele ngokubaluleka. Imisebenzi eminingi ihluleka ngoba umnikazi wesinqumo wadidwa izici iklabhu eyayingazidingi. Nikeza isidingo ngasinye isisindo ukuze uqhathanise abahlinzeki ngokulinganayo.

Hlanganisa abantu abazoyisebenzisa nsuku zonke, kusukela kubasebenzi basemnyango kuya kumgcini-sikhwama, bese ubamba izinkinga zabo. Gcina uhlu lufushane; izidingo eziyishumi nambili ezicacile ziyakhululeka ukuzihlola kuneziyishumi nanhlanu ezingacacile.

sections.heading: Amarekhodi nokulawula
paras: Hlola imikhondo ye-audit, izimvume ezincike ezikhundleni, izikhathi ezikhiyiwe nokulungiswa okunamakhodi ezizathu. Buza ukuthi umlando ugcinwa kanjani nokuthi amarekhodi angashintshwa yini ngaphandle komkhondo. Bhala phansi inqubo yakho yamanje ukuze ubone ukuthi yini ezoshintsha.

Hlola ukuthunyelwa: ingabe i-accountant yakho ingakusebenzisa? Amarekhodi ebhishi nesitoko angathunyelwa ngokuphelele? Nakekela ukuthi ukulungiswa kuphethwe kanjani. Amasistimu amahle afaka ukungena okuphindayo nesizathu esikhundleni sokubhala phezu kwelokuqala, okugcina umlando ugcwele.

sections.heading: Ukuqina nokusekela
paras: Hlola ukuziphatha ngaphandle kokuxhumeka, ukuhlanganiswa kwe-terminal yekhadi nezidingo zezinsiza. Buza ngamahora okusekela asendaweni, izikhathi zokuphendula nokuthi abasekeli bayakuqonda yini izimo zaseNingizimu Afrika njenge-load-shedding. Cela i-akhawunti ye-sandbox uhlole izimo zangempela, hhayi idatha yombukiso.
Hlola ukubamba idatha, amakhophi esipele nokuthi kwenzekani kudatha yakho uma uhamba. Cela inqubo yokuphuma ebhaliwe.

sections.heading: Izindleko nenkontileka
paras: Qhathanisa izindleko eziphelele eminyakeni emithathu ngamarandi, kufaka phakathi okubhaliselwe, izinsiza, ukuqeqeshwa nokusekelwa. Qaphela izindleko ngedivayisi noma ngelungu ezikhula njengoba ukhula. Hlola ukuthi imibiko ingahlungwa ngosuku, indawo nomsebenzisi.

Yenza uhlelo lokuhlola ngaphambi kokusayina bese uvumela ummeli wakho abuyekeze inkontileka, kufaka phakathi imibandela yokucubungula idatha. Uhlelo olufana ne-Budify lungahlolwa ngokuphathelene nalolu hlu njengabanye. Cela isiqinisekiso esibhaliwe sanoma yiziphi izithembiso ezenziwe ngesikhathi sezinkombiso, bese usigcina nerekhodi lesinqumo sakho.

sections.heading: Ukwethula
paras: Hlela ukushintsha ngokucophelela: hlanza idatha yakho yamalungu nesitoko kuqala, khetha usuku lokuqala kude nezikhathi eziphakeme bese uqhuba amasistimu amadala amasha ndawonye isikhathi esifushane. Qeqesha abasebenzi emaqenjini amancane ngemisebenzi yangempela. Zibale abahlinzeki ngamunye ngokuhambisana nohlu lwakho olunesisindo, urekhode izibalo nezizathu, bese ucela abantu ababili ukuthi babale ngokuzimela ngaphambi kokuqhathanisa. Lokhu kunciphisa ukuthambekela futhi kushiya irekhodi eliphelele lokuthi kungani kwakhethwa lokho.

Ngemuva kokuqala, buyekeza njalo ngeviki inyanga yokuqala: amaphutha, amathikithi osizo, impendulo yabasebenzi nemiphumela yokuvumelanisa. Gcina irekhodi lezinqumo ukuze ukubuyekezwa okulandelayo kube lula, bese uvumelana ngosuku lokuhlola ukuthi isistimu iyahlangabezana yini nezinhloso ozibeke. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Ukuphatha Kwekomidi Nokuxhumana Namalungu Eklabhwini Yangasese
description: Imikhuba emihle yokuphatha amakilabhu angasese amalungu aseNingizimu Afrika: ukubika kwekomidi, amaminithi, izaziso zamalungu nokuxhumana okuhlonipha imvume.

sections.heading: Ukuphatha kunikeza iklabhu ukuzinza
paras: Amakilabhu aba nempilo engcono lapho izinqumo zibonakala futhi zirekhodwa. Umthethosisekelo ocacile, imihlangano yekomidi evamile enamaminithi nendlela echaziwe yokuvuma izimali nemithetho kuvimbela izingxabano. Gcina amakhophi amaminithi asayiniwe endaweni ephephile.

Buyekeza umthethosisekelo unyaka ngamunye bese uwuvuselela ngokusemthethweni, kwaziswe amalungu futhi kurekhodwe usuku lokubuyekezwa. Qoka unobhala onekhalenda, uhlelo lomhlangano namaminithi, bese umnika onsiza.

sections.heading: Iphakheji yekomidi yenyanga
paras: Sebenzisa iphakheji eyisilinganiso: izinombolo zamalungu ngesigaba, abajoyine nabasishiyile, imali engenayo nezindleko ngamarandi, umehluko wesitoko, izigameko nezenzo zokulandela imithetho. Gcina ngamakhasi amabili ukuze abantu bafunde. Chaza ukuthi ubani ongakhuluma egameni leklabhu nabangaphandle.

Rekhoda izinqumo njengezixazululo ezinezinombolo ezinosuku, umphakamisi nomphumela. Zigcine endaweni eyodwa. Faka ingxenye emfushane yobungozi nezigameko ukuze izinkinga zixoxwe ngaphambi kokuba zikhule, bese urekhoda izenzo ezinabanikazi nezinsuku.

sections.heading: Ukuxhumana namalungu
paras: Nquma iziteshi nezinjongo: izaziso zesevisi, ukuvuselela, izinguquko zemithetho nemininingwane yemicimbi. Gcina ithoni ngokoqobo futhi ihloniphe. Nikeza indlela yokubuyekeza okuthandwayo kokuxhumana nokuphuma emilayezweni engeyibalulekile. Vumelana ngenqubo yokungqubuzana kwezintshisekelo bese urekhoda izimemezelo.

Gwema amaqembu engxoxo abonisa izinombolo zocingo zamalungu komunye nomunye; sebenzisa izinhlu zokusakaza noma imilayezo yesistimu. Gcina ifayela lezaziso ezithunyelwe, ukuze ukhombise ukuthi amalungu atshelwa ini nini.

sections.heading: Ukukhula okuhlala kuhlelekile
paras: Uma wengeza indawo yesibili noma ukhulisa ubulungu, khulisa ukulawula kuqala: izikhundla, izinqubo zokuvuma nokubika. Ukukhula ngaphandle kwenhlonipho yamarekhodi kuphindaphinda izinkinga. Hlinzeka iphakheji okungenani izinsuku ezimbili ngaphambi komhlangano.
Uhlelo olufana ne-Budify lungasekela izindawo eziningi ngokubika okwabelwanayo, kodwa ukuphatha kuwumsebenzi womuntu.

sections.heading: Ukugcina amarekhodi okuphatha
paras: Gcina ifayela lokuphatha elinomthethosisekelo, izinqubomgomo, amaminithi, izixazululo, ukuqokwa kwekomidi nemibiko yonyaka. Beka usuku inguqulo ngayinye bese ugcina ezindala ezifayelweni esikhundleni sokuzisusa. Khumbula ukuthi ukuphatha okuhle kuwumkhuba hhayi iphrojekthi. Iklabhu ehlangana njalo, irekhoda izinqumo, ibika obala futhi ibuyekeza umkhuba wayo ivame ukuphatha ukukhula, izingxabano nokuhlolwa ngokucindezeleka okuncane.

Rekhoda izimemezelo zezintshisekelo nokuthi ngayinye yaphathwa kanjani. Lokhu kuvikela iklabhu nabantu ngabodwana futhi kubonisa inqubo enobulungisa. Buyekeza ifayela unyaka ngamunye nonobhala bese uvuselela inkomba. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Ukubika Kweklabhu Enezindawo Eziningi: Amarekhodi Ahambisanayo Kuzo Zonke Izindawo
description: Indlela izinhlangano ezinezindawo eziningi eNingizimu Afrika zigcina ukubika kwamalungu, kwesitoko nemali kuhambisana futhi kulula ukubuyekezwa yikomidi.

sections.heading: Fanisa ngaphambi kokukhulisa
paras: Uma indawo ngayinye igcina amarekhodi ngendlela ehlukile, imibiko ehlanganisiwe ngeke ethenjwe. Chaza izigaba zamalungu ezijwayelekile, amagama ezinto zesitoko, amakhodi ezizathu nezinqubo ze-shift, bese uzisebenzisa yonke indawo. Hlola umhlahlandlela osezingeni endaweni eyodwa kuqala.

Shicilela umhlahlandlela omfushane wemisebenzi nekhalenda elilodwa lokubika, ukuze indawo ngayinye ivale inyanga yayo ngosuku olufanayo. Lapho indawo inezimo ezikhethekile zendawo, engeza isihlomulo esimakwe kahle emhlahlandlela esikhundleni sokudala inguqulo ehlukile.

sections.heading: Ukudluliselwa phakathi kwezindawo
paras: Isitoko esihamba phakathi kwezindawo kufanele sibe irekhodi lamasu amabili: lithunyelwa yindawo eyodwa futhi lamukelwe enye, ngamanani aqinisekiswe ezinhlangothini zombili. Izinto ezisendleleni zilandelelwa kuze kwamukelwe, futhi umehluko uphenyelwa ngokushesha. Sebenzisa ikhalenda elabelwanayo lezinsuku zokuphela kwenyanga.

Ungalungisi amanani ngokuthula ukuze ukudluliselwa kulingane. Sebenzisa ukulungiswa okubhaliwe okuvunyiwe. Vumelanisa ukudluliselwa njalo ngeviki hhayi ngenyanga, ukuze umehluko uphenyelwe ngenkathi imininingwane isashisa.

sections.heading: Imibono ehlanganisiwe neyezinga lendawo
paras: Amakomidi adinga zombili: isifinyezo esihlanganisiwe samalungu, imali engenayo ngamarandi, umehluko nezigameko, nokuhlukaniswa kwendawo ngayinye ukuze ahlolisise. Qhathanisa izindawo ngezilinganiso ezifanayo njengephesenti lomehluko nesikhathi sokuvumelanisa ikhadi. Qoka umnikazi oyedwa wohlu oluyinhloko lwamakhodi ezizathu.

Bheka okuphambene nokujwayelekile esikhundleni sokusola abantu ngabodwana; amagebe enqubo ngokuvamile yiwona mbangela. Sebenzisa usuku lokunqamula olufanayo kuzo zonke izindawo, bese uphawula noma yiyiphi indawo evala sekwephuzile, ukuze izibalo ezihlanganisiwe zethenjwe.

sections.heading: Ukulawula nezimo zendawo
paras: Nikeza umphathi onesibopho endaweni ngayinye, ezimvumeni ezikhawulelwe kudatha yaleyo ndawo. Abaphathi beqembu kufanele babe nokufinyelela okubanzi, okulawulwa ngokuqinile. Buyekeza umhlahlandlela unyaka ngamunye.

Indawo ngayinye ingase ibe nezidingo zendawo ezihlukile, ngakho ziqinisekise indawo ngendawo. Uhlelo olufana ne-Budify lungagcina izindawo eziningi ngaphansi kwe-akhawunti eyodwa, kodwa imibandela isetshwa yigunya lakho.

sections.heading: Ukubuyekeza nokuthuthukisa
paras: Yenza ucingo lwenyanga phakathi kwabaphathi bezindawo ukuqhathanisa imiphumela, ukuxoxa ngezigameko nokwabelana ngezixazululo. Zungezisa usihlalo ukuze indawo ngayinye ibambe iqhaza. Qaphela ukuvumela indawo ngayinye ukuthi izenzele imibiko ngokuthanda kwayo. Inqubo emfushane yokulawula izinguquko, lapho umbiko omusha noma ikhodi yesizathu ihlongozwa, ivunywe bese ikhishelwa zonke izindawo, igcina ukuqhathanisa kunobuqotho futhi ilondoloza umsebenzi ophindiwe.

Kanye ngonyaka, vakashela indawo ngayinye unohlu lokuhlola uqhathanise umkhuba nomhlahlandlela. Rekhoda okutholakele, vumelana ngezenzo bese ulandelela. Ukuhambisana kwakhiwa ngokuhlolwa okuphindaphindwayo, okungenabutha. Lolu ulwazi lwejwayelekile ngabaqhubi, hhayi iseluleko esingokomthetho; qinisekisa izidingo nommeli wasendaweni ofanelekile.

title: Amarekhodi aselungele i-audit: yini okufanele abaqhubi abalawulwayo bayirekhode, nokuthi kungani
description: Uhlu lokuhlola olusebenzayo lwamarekhodi enza ukuhlolwa nokubika kungabi nokucindezeleka, kubaqhubi abalawulwayo kuwo wonke amamakethe.

sections.heading: Kungani amarekhodi eyisithelo sangempela sokulandela imithetho
paras: Abalawuli bayivamile ukubuza ukuthi uhlela yini ukulandela imithetho. Bacela ubufakazi bokuthi uyilandelile. Kuwo wonke amamakethe alawulwayo, abaqhubi abaphatha kahle ukuhlolwa yilabo abakwazi ukukhiqiza amarekhodi aphelele, ahambisanayo anesikhathi ngamahora kunamasonto.
Lo mhlahlandlela ulwazi lwejwayelekile lwabaqhubi. Akuwona iseluleko esingokomthetho, futhi amarekhodi okufanele uwagcine incike kulayisense yakho, ezwenikazi lakho nomlawuli wakho.

sections.heading: Izigaba ezinhlanu ezifanele ukuthathwa yonke indawo
paras: Ukunyakaza kwesitoko: ukwamukela ngakunye, ukulungisa, ukudlulisela, ukubuyisa nokulahla, nokuthi ubani akwenzile nini. Ukubalwa kwesitoko: ukubala okuhleliwe nokungahleliwe, inani lesistimu ngaleso sikhathi, inani elibaliwe nomehluko ochaziwe.

Ukuqinisekiswa kobulungu noma kwamakhasimende: ukuthi ubuwena nokufaneleka kwahlolwa kanjani, nini, nangubani. Ama-transaction: lokho okurekhodwe endaweni yokukhokha noma yokwabela, kufaka phakathi okuhoxisiwe nokubuyiselwa kwemali. Ukufinyelela nezinguquko: ubani oshintshe amanani, imikhawulo, izimvume noma isimo selungu.

sections.heading: Yenza ilogi ibonakale uma kuthintiwe
paras: Irekhodi lingashintshwa ngokuthula yinoma ubani liyisikweletu. Khetha amasistimu lapho izinguquko zidala okufakiwe okusha esikhundleni sokubhala phezu kwakudala, lapho amaakhawunti abasebenzisi eyedwa ngamunye, nalapho ukuthunyelwa kungaphindwa.
Vumelana nomeluleki wakho ngesikhathi sokugcina bese ubhala phansi. Gcina okufanele ugcine; susa lokho ongasakudingi, ikakhulukazi idatha yomuntu siqu.

sections.heading: Zilolonge ukuthunyelwa ngaphambi kokuba ukudinge
paras: Kanye ngekota, khetha ububanzi bosuku bese ukhiqiza imibiko umlawuli ayicela ngokunengqondo. Uma kuthatha ngaphezu kwantambama eyodwa, lungisa inqubo ngenkathi kungekho muntu okulindele.

title: Ukubalwa kwesitoko okungabonakali: indlela elula ethola izinkinga kusenesikhathi
description: Indlela ukubala okungabonakali nemibiko yomehluko okusebenza ngayo, nokuthi ukwethule kanjani ezindaweni eziningana ngokulula nangempumelelo.

sections.heading: Okushiwo yilokho okuthi “akubonakali”
paras: Ekubaleni okungabonakali umuntu obalayo akaboni inani isistimu elilindele. Lokhu kususa isilingo sokuqinisekisa lokho okushiwo yisikrini futhi kwenza ukubala kuthembeke kakhulu.

sections.heading: Isimiso esingaphindwa
paras: Khetha ububanzi (zonke izinto noma isigaba esisodwa), vimba ukunyakaza endaweni ebalwayo, bala, bese ubuyekeza umehluko kuphela. Phenya umehluko ongaphezu komkhawulo ovunyelwene ngaphambi kokulungisa noma yini.

Rekhoda isizathu sokulungisa ngakunye. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi izizathu uqobo luba wusizo: ukuncipha okuphindaphindwayo esigabeni esisodwa, noma endaweni eyodwa, kukhomba inkinga yenqubo hhayi inhlanhla embi.

sections.heading: Ukukwethula ezindaweni eziningana
paras: Sebenzisa ishejuli nemikhawulo efanayo endaweni ngayinye, nikeza ababali amaakhawunti abo, bese ugcina ukuvuma ukulungiswa kubaphathi. Qhathanisa umehluko ngendawo, hhayi kuphela esambeni esiphelele.

title: Izisekelo zokuphathwa kobulungu kwezinhlangano namakilabhu
description: Amarejista, imikhawulo namadokhumenti izinhlangano zobulungu ezivame ukuwagcina, ukuze ukuphathwa kobulungu kuhlale kuhlelekile futhi kulandeleke.

sections.heading: Irejista ongayethemba
paras: Izinhlangano zobulungu, kuqala, ziyabaphathi. Irejista yamalungu ethembekile irekhoda ukuthi ubani ojoyine, nini, ngaphansi kwemibandela yini, nokuthi ubulungu bakhe busebenza yini njengamanje.

Imithetho iyahlukahluka ngezwe nesifunda, kwezinye izindawo umsebenzi wezinhlangano ezinjalo uvinjelwe noma awusazinzile emthethweni. Funa njalo iseluleko somthetho sasendaweni; lesi sihloko sichaza ukuphatha, hhayi ilungelo lokusebenza.

sections.heading: Isimo, ukuphelelwa nemikhawulo
paras: Landelela isimo sobulungu nokuphelelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo, bese wenza ukucisha kube ngokushesha. Uma imithetho yakho ifaka imikhawulo yokwabela, rekhoda ukwabela ngakunye kulelungu ukuze imikhawulo ihlolwe ngaphambi kokwabela okulandelayo.

sections.heading: Amadokhumenti nokuvikelwa kwedatha
paras: Gcina kuphela amadokhumenti owadingayo, uwagcine ngokuphepha, bese ukhawulela ukufinyelela ngesikhundla. Amarekhodi amalungu angaba ngobucayi: vumelana ngezikhathi zokugcina, hlonipha izicelo zokufinyelela nokususwa, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi umhlinzeki wakho wesofthiwe usayina isivumelwano sokucubungula idatha.
